title: 第7章 各种至宝震撼众人第8章 家族的安排
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 三祖看到来人，一点也不意外，只是淡淡的说道。
而要说整个林家，谁最渴望获得帝级功法，那肯定非大祖林长霄莫属了。
别说帝级功法，哪怕准帝级功法林长霄都做梦都想得到一部，因为只有那样，他才能突破到更高的境界，从而带领林家更上一层楼。
原本大祖林长霄和二祖林长雪，都在各自的洞府闭关潜修，虽然他们也察觉到了林天海两人到来，但并未出现，反正只要不是太大的事，老三足以解决了。
可是如今听到有一部帝级功法，还是最适合他的雷属性功法，大祖林长霄哪里还坐得住，当即便和二祖林长雪出现在了众人上空。
于是，便有了刚才那一幕。
只见大祖林长霄对着众人点了点头，然后抬手一挥一股磅礴的灵力突然出现，瞬间便将众人扶了起来，紧接着便再次开口：
“可是真的帝级功法？拿来让我看看……”
三祖也没有说啥，直接便将手上的功法，送到了大祖手里。
只见在拿到功法的第一时间，大祖林长霄便立马查看了起来。
大祖林长霄很快便将《九霄雷帝诀》大致浏览了一遍，虽然他没修炼过，但他依然能看出此功法的深奥和强大。
甚至他觉得，这功法可能还要远超一般的帝级功法……
这功法对于他来说，简直再适合不过了！
“哈哈哈，有了此功法，老夫突破准帝指日可待，我林家很快便可更上一层楼！”
大祖林长霄看完后，大笑道。
他等这一天等太久了，如今终于圆满了！
“恭喜大哥！祝大哥早日突破准帝境，带领我林家更上一层楼！”
“恭喜大祖！祝大祖早日突破准帝！”
一旁的众人也是纷纷恭贺道。
而大祖林长霄只是笑着点了点头，便转头看向了一旁的林轩，笑着说道：
“轩儿，这功法是你获得的，说吧想要什么奖赏？只要老祖做得到的，老祖通通答应你！”
“是啊，轩儿，你尽管说，老祖们什么都答应你，呵呵”
从始至终都未曾说话的二祖林长雪，也是笑着说道。
就连一旁的众多族老也是纷纷凑热闹道：
“轩儿，你为我林家立下了如此大的功劳，就算你要其他圣族的圣女，族老我都给你抢过来！”
“轩儿，你说以前有没有欺负你的小辈，老夫我这就去把他们家的老不死都揍一遍，给你出气！”
“刚好老夫有一朵下品圣火暂时存放于火元宗中，轩儿喜不喜欢？喜欢的话，族老我今天便去给你取来！”
不是
族老你们正经点好嘛？
不知道的还以为我林家是什么魔道势力呢……
林轩内心腹诽不已，但表面上没有丝毫表现。
林轩也知道各位老祖和族老是为他好，他也很高兴自己能有这样一群长辈。
这也是他林家和其它势力最大的不同之处，其它势力不是勾心斗角，就是只顾自己，而他林家至少大部分族人，都是和睦相处，虽然有竞争，但那都是良性竞争，更不会出现勾心斗角、残害族人的现象。
“各位老祖、族老，晚辈并不需要奖励。”
“晚辈身为林家的一份子，更是林家少主，为家族做贡献这是应该的，而且……”
“晚辈可没说只有这《九霄雷帝诀》一样宝物……嘿嘿”
林轩笑着开口道。
“什么！还有？”
众人震惊道。
就连林家三位老祖，都不由得惊讶的望着林轩，仿佛想要将他看穿一样。
“轩儿，还有？快拿出来看看！”
林天海震惊过后，开口道。
content_en:
The Third Ancestor was not surprised at all when he saw the person coming, and just said calmly.
And among the entire Lin family, who is most eager to obtain the emperor-level skills, it must be the great ancestor Lin Changxiao.
Not to mention the emperor-level skills, even the quasi-emperor-level skills Lin Changxiao dreamed of getting one, because only then could he break through to a higher realm and lead the Lin family to a higher level.
Originally, the eldest ancestor Lin Changxiao and the second ancestor Lin Changxue were in retreat in their respective caves. Although they also noticed the arrival of Lin Tianhai and the others, they did not appear. Anyway, as long as it was not a big deal, the third child could handle it.
But now that he heard that there was an emperor-level skill, which was the most suitable thunder attribute skill for him, how could the eldest ancestor Lin Changxiao still sit still, when even his second ancestor Lin Changxue appeared above everyone.
So, the scene just happened.
The Great Ancestor Lin Changxiao nodded to everyone, then raised his hand and waved a majestic spiritual power that suddenly appeared, instantly lifting everyone up, and then spoke again:
"But is it really an emperor-level skill? Show it to me..."
The Third Ancestor didn't say anything, and directly sent the technique in his hand to the Great Ancestor.
As soon as he got the technique, Grand Ancestor Lin Changxiao immediately checked it.
Grand Ancestor Lin Changxiao quickly browsed through the "Nine Heavens Thunder Emperor Technique". Although he had never practiced it, he could still see the profoundness and power of this technique.
He even felt that this technique might be far superior to ordinary emperor-level techniques...
This technique is perfect for him!
"Hahaha, with this technique, I will be able to break through to the Quasi-Emperor soon, and my Lin family will soon be able to reach a higher level!"
Grand Ancestor Lin Changxiao laughed after reading it.
He has been waiting for this day for too long, and now it is finally complete!
"Congratulations, eldest brother! I wish eldest brother to break through to the quasi-emperor realm as soon as possible and lead my Lin family to a higher level!"
"Congratulations to the Great Ancestor! I wish the Great Ancestor to break through to the Quasi-Emperor as soon as possible!"
Everyone on the side also congratulated.
The great ancestor Lin Changxiao just smiled and nodded, then turned to look at Lin Xuan aside, and said with a smile:
"Xuan'er, you got this skill, tell me what reward you want? As long as the ancestor can do it, the ancestor will promise you everything!"
"Yes, Xuan'er, just say it, the ancestors will promise you anything, haha"
Second ancestor Lin Changxue, who had not spoken a word from beginning to end, also said with a smile.
Even the many clan elders on the side joined in the fun and said:
"Xuan'er, you have made such great contributions to my Lin family. Even if you want a saint from another saint clan, I will snatch it for you, elder!"
"Xuan'er, tell me if there were any juniors who bullied you before. I'm going to beat up all the old immortals in their family right now to vent your anger!"
"It just so happens that I have a low-grade holy fire that is temporarily stored in the Huoyuan Sect. Does Xuan'er like it? If you like it, I will go get it for you today, clan elder!"
…
No
Clan elders, can you be more serious?
Those who don’t know think that my Lin family is some kind of demonic force...
Lin Xuan cursed in his heart, but showed no signs of it on the surface.
Lin Xuan also knows that all the ancestors and clansmen are always good for him, and he is very happy to have such a group of elders.
This is also the biggest difference between his Lin family and other forces. Other forces either scheming or only care about themselves, but at least most of his Lin family's clan members live in harmony. Although there is competition, it is all healthy competition, and there will be no intrigues or harm to clan members.
"Dear ancestors, clan elders, and juniors do not need rewards."
"As a member of the Lin family, and also as the young master of the Lin family, this junior should contribute to the family, and..."
"Junior didn't say that there is only one treasure called "Nine Heavens Thunder Emperor Technique"...hehe"
Lin Xuan said with a smile.
"What! More?"
Everyone was shocked.
Even the three ancestors of the Lin family couldn't help but look at Lin Xuan in surprise, as if they wanted to see through him.
"Xuan'er, do you still have it? Take it out and have a look!"
Lin Tianhai said after being shocked.
